Pupil / Student–Teacher Ratio (PTR) by Level

Learners per classroom teacher currently on record for that level. Lower generally means less crowded classrooms.

Filters

By Level — Enrolment, Gender Parity & PTR

GPI (Gender Parity Index) = Girls ÷ Boys enrolment; 0.95–1.05 is treated as balanced. Teacher counts are each school's own self-reported trained-teacher figures for that level (Second Cycle: total teaching staff reported by the school), summed the same way as enrolment; when a Circuit filter is applied, only schools in that circuit are included.
